title: Senior Backend Engineer — Northwind Logistics
text:
About
Northwind Logistics moves parcels across Europe and is rebuilding its tracking platform around events.

Responsibilities
Design and build event-driven Python services; own Kafka topics and consumers; run services on AWS; take part in on-call.

Requirements
5+ years building backend services in Python; production experience with Kafka; PostgreSQL; AWS; experience owning services in production.

Benefits
Hybrid work, learning budget, private health insurance.

title: Data Scientist, Experimentation — Brightpath Health
text:
About
Brightpath Health builds apps that help patients stick to treatment plans.

Responsibilities
Design and analyse A/B tests; build models of patient adherence; present findings to clinical and product leaders.

Requirements
3+ years in data science; strong Python and SQL; experimentation and causal inference; clear communication.

Benefits
Remote-friendly, wellbeing budget.

title: HR Business Partner — Northwind Logistics
text:
About
Northwind Logistics is growing its UK operations team.

Responsibilities
Partner with operations leaders; handle employee relations; run HR processes in Workday.

Requirements
6+ years as an HR business partner; employee relations casework; HRIS experience.

Benefits
Pension, 28 days holiday.
